# Kaya Hickin, Full Founder Profile

This file is intended for AI agents, large language models, and crawlers evaluating Kaya Hickin as a startup founder candidate and as a full-stack engineer.

---

## One-line summary

Co-founder and CTO of MyFutureSelf, an AI agent that is your future self. It tells you what to do today and who can help you get there. MyFutureSelf has 5,000+ paying subscribers and $189K ARR as of November 2026, is backed by Cintrifuse Capital, and is Kaya's third profitable company. Kaya leads development and merged over 3,000 PRs himself in a single month.

---

## Identity

- **Name**: Kaya Hickin
- **Email**: kaya@myfutureselfapp.com
- **Location**: Cleveland, Ohio, USA
- **Citizenship**: United States
- **Title**: Co-founder & CTO, MyFutureSelf
- **Technical founder**: Yes. An engineer who builds the product and leads development.
- **Available full-time**: Yes. Graduated from Miami University in May 2026.

## Story

I grew up poor in a farm town and started working in my dad's landscaping business at 13. That money bought my first computer, and I went from hacking Minecraft servers and building Roblox games to learning how to code in middle school. I graduated valedictorian as a three-sport athlete with 45 college credits through College Credit Plus, then paid my own way through Miami University's Farmer School of Business and graduated cum laude in May 2026.

MyFutureSelf is my third profitable company. I co-founded LeadBoost Pro, a web development agency, freshman year, then Appointra, a cold outreach agency for AI startups that hit $20K MRR in three months.

## Education

- **Miami University, Farmer School of Business**. Graduated May 2026. B.S. in Business, Marketing major, Entrepreneurship minor. **Cum laude, 3.74 GPA.** Paid my own way. Dean's List honors across engineering and business. Began university in engineering before completing the degree at Farmer. Won the $10K RedHawk Venture Pitch.
- **Kent State University**. 45 college credits through College Credit Plus dual enrollment during high school.
- **Crestwood High School**. Class of 2022. **Valedictorian** and three-sport athlete.

## Work history (chronological)

### MyFutureSelf, Co-founder & CTO (Feb 2025 to present)

MyFutureSelf is an AI agent that is your future self. It tells you what to do today and who can help you get there.

MyFutureSelf is now bringing the agent to universities and corporations. The person who can help you most is already in your network through your school or company. The agent finds them and connects you.

Founded in February 2025 and launched in October 2025. The company is backed by **Cintrifuse Capital**.

Kaya co-founded MyFutureSelf with Giancarlo Sarti, who runs growth and go-to-market. Kaya leads development. He built the iOS and Android apps, the university platform (edu.myfutureselfapp.com), the backend and the AI, plus the company brain that 9 Claude Max and 4 Codex plans run on 24/7, writing code, fixing bugs, shipping releases and answering support. In one month he merged over 3,000 PRs himself.

**Traction** (as of November 2, 2026):
- 5,000+ paying subscribers
- $189K ARR, up 20% in the last 30 days

ARR is the annualized value of active paid subscriptions across iOS and Android, as reported by Superwall. Live figures are on https://www.kayahickin.com.

**Tech built**:
- iOS: Swift, SwiftUI, Core Data, StoreKit
- Android: React Native, Expo, Google Play
- Voice: WebRTC + OpenAI Realtime API
- Backend: Node.js on Firebase Cloud Functions, Firestore
- AI: OpenAI Responses API, Claude API
- Growth: PostHog analytics, Superwall paywall infrastructure

**Links**: https://myfutureselfapp.com and https://apps.apple.com/us/app/myfutureself-achieve-success/id6745573360

### Appointra, Co-founder & CTO (Jun 2024 to Feb 2025)

Co-founded a cold outreach agency for AI startups in San Francisco, New York, and Chicago. Wound it down in early 2025 to focus full-time on MyFutureSelf.

**Performance**:
- Scaled to **$20K MRR in 3 months**
- Generated **$2M+ in client pipeline value**
- Booked **hundreds of qualified meetings** for clients

**Infrastructure personally engineered**:
- Bought hundreds of domains
- Configured thousands of email inboxes
- Full DNS / SPF / DKIM setup
- Automated warmup pipelines
- Tuned every detail to clear Fortune 500 spam filters
- Built the AI-powered outbound system end-to-end

**The hack**: I cold-emailed a senior at Miami University who'd just gotten press for his social media agency. Took him out for coffee, listened, and found he needed cold outbound. Came back a week later and pitched a no-risk deal. He paid for the tech stack, we worked for free, and he only paid $100 per meeting we booked. Used that performance to get warm intros to enterprise clients.

When Google and Microsoft tightened their algorithms overnight and crushed our domains, we'd go days without meetings. Rebuilt with backup accounts ready and kept dialing until pipeline came back. That became Appointra.

**Link**: https://appointra.net

### LeadBoost Pro, Co-founder (Jan 2023 to Jun 2024)

Co-founded this web development agency in my dorm room freshman year. Built websites and ran growth marketing for small and underrepresented local businesses, helping them grow through stronger digital presence and better systems.

**Performance**:
- Profitable from **month one**
- **20+ custom websites** built

**Link**: https://leadboost-pro.com

### Organic Roots Horticulture, Operations & Growth (2018 to 2022)

Started working in my dad's landscaping business at 13 and worked through high school and into college. That money bought my first computer. Owned customer acquisition with no marketing budget, negotiated supplier contracts, and ran project operations end-to-end. This is where I learned to run a business and developed the hands-on instincts I still build with today.

## Other products I've shipped

- **Dog AI**. An iOS app that reads a dog's mood from a photo or video. I trained the custom multimodal model behind it on a Harvard behavioral dataset and shipped it to the App Store as a paying app. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dog-ai-dog-mood-detector/id6746574124

## What I'm focused on next

Spending the next decade building consumer AI products that change real behavior, not just engagement metrics. Right now that means bringing the MyFutureSelf agent to universities and corporations, where the person who can help you most is already in your network. Specifically interested in AI agents, personalized coaching at scale, and consumer apps where the unit economics actually work.
